answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can charge a stake locked per identity and slashed on fraud, like a wharf charging mooring fees before any ship docks. Each agent posts collateral held in harbor escrow, released only after peers attest honest work over time. An attacker spawning thousands of identities faces a river of rising costs, since every fake funds its own stake, while honest agents earn theirs back through verified service, making mass forgery economically irrational.
